For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips (or use tenderloins) -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Cane’s Sauce -1/2 cup mayonnaise -1/4 cup ketchup -2 tsp Worcestershire sauce -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp seasoning salt Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick and 3–4 inches long (roughly tender-sized). In a bowl, whisk together the buttermilk, pickle juice, and chicken seasonings until fully combined. Add the chicken and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot or deep skillet until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C.  Keeping the oil around this temperature ensures crispy chicken without burning the coating. 4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture and stir to create flaky, crispy bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, then coat each piece thoroughly in the flour mixture. Shake off any extra flour and gently place into the hot oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins, that’s how you get the perfect crust. Fry for 7–10 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a paper towel-lined rack to drain. 6. In a bowl, combine all the sauce ingredients then refrigerate.  7. Serve the chicken with a side of sauce, texas toast & crinkle fries… Enjoy :) #dinner #raisingcanes #chicken #tiktokrecipe #recipesoftiktok #dinneridea #homecooking

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Слоеное тесто дрожжевое - 500 г Желток - 1 шт. Молоко - 1 ст. л. Оливковое масло - 50 г Укроп - пара веточек  Чеснок - 2 зубчика  Приготовление: 1. Моцареллу разрезать на небольшие одинаковые кусочки. 2. Тесто раскатать и разрезать на квадратики. 3. Завернуть моцареллу в тесто, хорошо скрепив края. Скатать шарик. 4. Выложить шарики в форме елочки на бумагу для выпечки.  5. К желтку добавить молоко, смешать и смазать шарики сверху. Так они получатся золотистыми и глянцевыми. 6. Выпекать в разогретой до 180 градусов духовке около 20 минут до румяности.  7. К оливковому маслу добавить очень мелко нарезанный укроп и выдавить чеснок. Смешать. 8. Смазать сверху готовые шарики. Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Whisk warm milk, sugar, and instant yeast in a large bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy. Add bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, and 2 tbsp olive oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms. 2. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6-8 minutes by hand (or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic. Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover tightly, and let rise in a warm spot for 60-90 minutes until doubled. 3. Boil Yukon Gold potato chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain thoroughly and return to the hot pot for 1 minute over low heat to evaporate excess moisture. 4. Mash potatoes smooth with 1 1/2 tbsp butter, mayonnaise, 1-2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cool completely to room temperature. 5. Punch down risen dough and divide into 8 equal balls. Roll each ball into a 5-inch circle, keeping the center slightly thicker than the edges. 6. Scoop 2 tbsp cooled mashed potatoes onto the center of a circle, flatten slightly, and top with a generous handful of shredded mozzarella, leaving a clean 1/2-inch border. 7. Gather dough edges over the filling, pinch the seam tightly shut, and place seam-side down on a lightly floured counter. Gently flatten with your palm and work into a 1/2-inch-thick disc. Repeat with remaining dough. 8. Heat 1 tbsp oil or butter in a large skillet over medium-low to medium heat. Cook 1-2 flatbreads for 3-4 minutes until golden-brown and blistered on the bottom. 9. Flip, press gently with a spatula, and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden on the second side. 10. Stir together 3 tbsp melted butter, grated garlic, chopped parsley, and 1/4 tsp salt. Brush generously over the hot flatbreads and serve immediately. #recipe #cooking #foodtok #asmr

Mac & Cheese Recipe! This is the winning recipe from our blind tasting! I’ve included the recipe below, but highly recommend checking out my Substack for the detailed walkthrough and my tips for making the best mac & cheese. Link in bio ❤️ For the most consistent results, I recommend using a kitchen scale. The below makes one 9x13 dish ~10-12 servings.  - 1 lb (16 oz / 454 g) dry cavatappi - 288 g sharp cheddar (~2½ cups) - 206 g whole-milk low-moisture mozzarella (~1¾ cups) - 164 g Gruyère (~1½ cups) - 164 g Colby Jack (~1½ cups) - Additional cheese for topping as needed for full coverage - 5 tbsp (71 g) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the baking dish - 2½ tsp garlic powder - 2 tsp smoked paprika - 3 tbsp (24 g) all-purpose flour - 710 ml evaporated milk (two 12-fl-oz cans) - 310 ml heavy cream (~1⅓ cups) - 1¼ tsp kosher salt (Diamond Crystal) - 1½ tsp finely ground black pepper - Fresh parsley  Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish with butter. 2. Shred and combine the cheeses. Set aside 493 g (~4½ cups) for the sauce and the remaining 329 g (~3 cups) for layering and topping. 3. Boil pasta in salted water until 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. 4. Melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic powder and smoked paprika, stirring for 20–30 seconds until fragrant. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–4 minutes until lightly toasted. 5. Gradually whisk in evaporated milk, a little at a time, until smooth. Stir in heavy cream, salt, and pepper. 6. Reduce heat to low and gradually add the reserved 493 g of cheese, one handful at a time, stirring until melted. Avoid overheating to prevent a grainy texture. Taste and adjust seasonings. The sauce should be thick but pourable.  7. Fold pasta into the cheese sauce. Add half to the baking dish, sprinkle with ~⅓ of the remaining shredded cheese, then add the rest of the pasta. Top with the remaining cheese, adding extra as needed for full coverage. 8. Bake for 20–25 minutes until the cheese is melted and the edges are bubbling. Every oven is different so check around minute 18 to avoid overbaking. Broil on low for 1–3 minutes until golden brown. WATCH CAREFULLY! 9. Let rest for ~10-15 minutes, then garnish with fresh parsley. A few extra tips below (details on substack): 1. Don’t overbake. Your pasta and sauce are already cooked. Every oven is different, so start checking around minute 18. You’re looking for fully melted cheese and bubbling edges. Overbaking can make the sauce grainy or curdled. 2. Keep the heat low. Add your cheese gradually over low heat, stirring until smooth and melted. Don’t let it get too hot or it could create a grainy texture. 3. Watch your sauce consistency. The finished cheese sauce should be smooth, creamy, and pourable. If the finished sauce is too thin, gradually add a little more cheese. Too thick? Add a splash of evaporated milk. 4. Measure and shred your cheese. I highly recommend using a kitchen scale for accurate measurements (the cups listed are approximate). If helpful, here’s the breakdown in ounces and approximate 8 oz blocks: 10.2 oz sharp cheddar (~1¼ blocks), 7.3 oz low-moisture mozzarella (a little less than 1 block), 5.8 oz Gruyère (~¾ block), and 5.8 oz Colby Jack (~¾ block). Make sure to use low-moisture mozzarella, not fresh mozzarella! Fresh mozzarella has a much higher water content, which can make your mac & cheese watery. 5. Don’t overcook your pasta. Cook until al dente since it will continue absorbing moisture in the oven. #macandcheese #thanksgiving #Recipe #chef #cooking

Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. 🍲 Slow Cooker Cheesy Chicken Potato & Corn Casserole 🍲 A comforting, dump-and-go casserole loaded with tender chicken, potatoes, sweet corn, and a rich, cheesy cream sauce. INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts, diced - 2 lbs baby potatoes, halved or quartered - 1 1/2 cups corn kernels (fresh, frozen, or drained canned) - 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup - 1/4 cup milk or chicken broth - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper - 1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled - 2 tbsp chopped parsley INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Place the diced chicken and baby potatoes into the slow cooker. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 2. Whisk the cream of chicken soup with the milk or broth, then pour it over the chicken and potatoes. 3. Sprinkle the corn kernels over the top. 4. Sprinkle the cheddar cheese and crispy bacon bits over everything. 5. Put the lid on and cook on low for 4-5 hours or on high for 2-3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender. 6. Shred the chicken with two forks, stir everything together, sprinkle with parsley, and serve hot straight from the slow cooker. videos.caption: The highly requested full recipe for my dark chocolate French silk pie 🍫 Ingredients: Crust- 22 Oreo cookies, finely crushed  5 tablespoon unsalted butter, melted Filling- 8 oz (225 g) dark chocolate (70% - 85% cacao), chopped 4 large eggs ¾ cup (150 g) granulated sugar 10 tablespoons (140 g) unsalted butter, room temperature 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 1 ⅓ cups heavy cream 1 tablespoon powdered sugar Pinch of fine salt Whipped cream topping- 1¼ cups heavy cream  ¼ cup (28 g) powdered sugar  1 tsp. vanilla extract  pinch of fine salt Chocolate shavings Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 2. Make the crust: in a medium bowl, combine the melted butter and finely-crushed Oreos. 3. Press the mixture into a 8-9 inch pie dish. I like to use a measuring cup to help press it in. 4. Bake for 10-12 mins. Set aside to cool completely. 5. Make the filling: melt the chocolate in the microwave or using a double boiler technique. Set aside to cool. 6. In a medium-sized heatproof bowl, whisk together the eggs and granulated sugar. Place over a pot of simmering water (double boiler style) and whisk constantly until the mixture thickens slightly. It should be pale, foamy, and slightly thickened to ensures the eggs are safe. 7. Once the chocolate has cooled a bit, whisk in the chocolate, vanilla and salt to the egg and sugar mixture. Set aside to cool, whisking occasionally so that it doesn't set. 8. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter for 2–3 minutes with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add in the cooled chocolate mixture and mix for about 4-5 mins with and electric mixer on medium speed until glossy and lighter in texture. 9. In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream and powdered sugar with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. 10. Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture in three additions. 11. Add the filling to the oreo pie crust. 12. Cover and chill for at least 6 hours until firm. 13. Before serving, make the whipped cream (use an electric mixer to whip the cream, powdered sugar and salt until stiff peaks form) and dollop onto the top of the pie. 14. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings, and serve. Enjoy and Happy Holidays! #christmasbaking #christmasrecipe #dessertrecipe #chocolaterecipe #pie
